transcript.text: Hello Microsoft, my name is Ipti Saham Akzal and I am currently a second year student of Bachelor of Computer Science at COMSET Saiwal.
So talking about the technical skills that I have learned so far are C, C++, Python and during my recent semester break I have decided to learn front-end development using HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
I started techie courses on platforms like Coursera and YouTube.
These resources enable me to make some amazing projects like clone websites, e-mail templates, and much more.
While I was learning, I realized that I really like help learning people too.
I enjoyed showing my friends how to do cool things with coding.
I have also passed the Microsoft Office Special Ed test by scoring 953 marks out of 1000 and earned a certificate from Microsoft.
And my teachers encouraged me to guide and help my peers with this test too.
so I shared them tips, strategies, and resources for it.
This showed me that sharing what I have learned is what I enjoyed the most.
As an MLSA, my goal is to create a supportive environment at my campus.
With my skills and dedication, I aim to help my fellow students to explore the fascinating technologies.
From coding workshops to study sessions, I will be there to help my university colleagues in tackling their challenges.
Being approachable and ready to assist is what I'm aiming for.
So that's it from my side.
